Maintainer.Profile: Unraid templates maintained by Cody Burker: self-hosted LAN party and board game platforms. Currently packages Rumpus (Jackbox-style: shared TV screen + phones as controllers), GameNight (party games: social deduction, UNO, trivia, drawing), and LAN Games (turn-based board game classics with accounts and persistence). Images are built from pinned, test-gated upstream commits via GitHub Actions and published to GHCR.
